cases.name: Sharon A. Provance Guthrie
cases.about: She graduated from Platte Valley Bible College in 1967. She worked in the business office of Sears and Alco, was a teacher's aide for handicapped children and was currently employed at the Reed Clinic in Huron. She was a member of First Presbyterian Church of Wolsey, Theta Roe and Extension Clubs.
cases.narrative: EMTs found her naked and face-down in an empty tub. Her husband claimed he found her and could not move her so he drained the tub and called 911. He put the sleep medication Temazepam in her chocolate milk to sedate her, placed her in their bathtub, filled it with water and drowned her.
